description: Replace torch.geqrf for n=512 batched cases with a CUTE DSL blocked Householder QR kernel that maps one matrix to a persistent CTA cluster, computes panel norms/reductions and trailing updates in tiled shared memory, and falls back to torch.geqrf for larger n until correctness is proven.

Build a CUTE DSL specialization for upper-triangular and band or near-rank stress cases that detects cheap structural patterns per matrix, emits compact Householder factors with identity or near-identity reflectors where valid, and routes unsupported dense matrices to torch.geqrf.

Implement a CUTE DSL tiled unblocked Householder path for small n=32,176,352 using one CTA per matrix with warp-level reductions and in-place H and tau output, keeping torch.geqrf fallback for n>=512 to reduce geomean tail without risking large-shape correctness.

Stabilize CUTE DSL availability and multiprocessing launch inside submission.py, then build a correctness-gated n=512 panel diagnostic kernel that computes Householder norms and tau for one panel but falls back to torch.geqrf unless compact H/tau validation passes for every checked matrix.

Starting from the valid CUTE QR32 branch, implement an independent CUTE DSL n=176 specialization using multi-warp panel reductions and shared-memory column state rather than generalizing QR32 code; keep QR32 unchanged and fallback to torch.geqrf unless n=176 residual and orthogonality checks pass.

Combine the valid CUTE QR32 warp fast path from c8dccb52 with the valid 4096 upper-triangular and 512 rankdef structural fast paths from b7f90d95, preserving exact dispatch gates and falling back to torch.geqrf for all other cases; resolve conflicts minimally and benchmark whether the specialized paths compose.

Extend the validated CUTE n=512 first-panel primitive into a correctness-gated output-writing path for only the first Householder column: write H[:,1:,0] and tau[:,0], compare against torch.geqrf on sampled matrices inside the dispatch gate, and keep torch.geqrf fallback unless compact H/tau and downstream QR residual checks pass.

Combine d683127f's valid QR32, 4096 upper-triangular, and 512 rankdef structural CUTE paths with 94bed359's valid independent n=176 CUTE specialization; preserve exact dispatch predicates, do not broaden content-based gates, and keep torch.geqrf fallback for all other shapes.

Starting from the combined best branch, build a conservative CUTE DSL dense and mixed n=512 blocked Householder specialization for only the benchmark's batch-640 n=512 cases, using panel width 8 or 16, shared-memory reductions, and tiled trailing updates; keep existing fast paths unchanged and fallback unless full QR residual and orthogonality guards pass.

Replace 964bdcba's n=176 dispatch arm with 9673e143's faster shared-memory-cached n=176 CUTE specialization while preserving 964bdcba's QR32, 4096 upper, and 512 rankdef predicates exactly; keep torch.geqrf fallback for all other cases and benchmark composition.

Extend the valid n=512 CUTE output-writing first-column path to a two-column mini-panel: compute and write Householder columns 0 and 1 plus tau[0:2], apply the first reflector update before the second, and keep fallback unless compact H/tau comparison and downstream QR residual and orthogonality checks pass.

Extend the clustered n=512 tau-pad256 CUTE path to mixed batch-640 n=512 cases by adding per-matrix structural detection for clustered or near-rank-like matrices, routing only detected matrices through the 256-column path while leaving dense matrices and all existing QR32, n=176, 4096 upper, and rankdef paths unchanged; fallback unless full guards pass.

Starting from the best stacked CUTE branch, implement an independent n=352 CUTE Householder specialization using 256 or 512 threads with multi-warp reductions and shared-memory active-column caching; keep QR32, n=176, n=512 structural, and 4096 upper paths unchanged, and fallback unless n=352 residual and orthogonality checks pass.

Build an exact-shape n=1024 batch-60 structural fast path for near-rank or mixed matrices using cheap per-matrix detection and a CUTE DSL prefix-factor/tau-padding strategy analogous to the valid n=512 rankdef and clustered paths; preserve all existing dispatch arms and fallback unless full validation guards pass.

Optimize the mixed batch-640 n=512 routing overhead without changing math: replace advanced-index gather and scatter plus repeated sub-batch geqrf calls with cheaper contiguous mask grouping or preallocated buffers for rankdef and clustered subsets, preserving exact dispatch gates and all fast paths; keep only if validation passes and geomean improves.

Combine the current best QR352 CUTE specialization from e0a0ef8 with the n=1024 batch-60 structural path from f08569a and the n=512 routing-reduction reuse from f699dd5; preserve each exact shape and content dispatch gate plus existing QR32, n=176, n=512 structural, and 4096 upper paths, with torch.geqrf fallback otherwise.

Combine the latest QR352 CUTE specialization from 538560b with the n=1024 structural split path from 6cb233a and the n=512 routing-reduction reuse from f699dd5; preserve each exact shape and content dispatch gate, transplant all required helper functions, keep existing QR32, n=176, n=512 structural, and 4096 upper paths, and fall back to torch.geqrf otherwise.

Replace only the QR352 CUTE dispatch implementation and tuning in the combined best 7c6c4636 branch with the latest 64-thread, 2-warp QR352 retune from 502e8ea; preserve all n=1024 structural helpers, n=512 routing reductions, QR32, n=176, n=512 structural, 4096 upper paths, exact gates, and torch.geqrf fallback.

Reduce QR352 launch overhead by fusing each Householder panel kernel with a small batch of trailing-column updates, or batching multiple update columns per launch while preserving the validated 64-thread, 2-warp arithmetic and exact n=352 dispatch; keep existing fast paths unchanged and fallback or revert unless validation passes and n=352 plus geomean improves.

Reduce combined branch routing and indexing overhead for n=512 and n=1024 mixed structural paths: reuse batch-level reductions across gates, avoid repeated boolean indexing or nonzero calls, and short-circuit dense all-fallback cases before constructing masks, preserving exact predicates and math; keep only if validation passes and geomean improves.

Build an exact-shape n=2048 batch-8 structural detector and fast path for rank-deficient or near-low-rank cases if present, using a prefix geqrf plus CUTE tau-padding and zero-tail cleanup strategy analogous to the n=1024 path; preserve all existing paths and fallback for dense unless detection is certain and full validation passes.

Replace the QR352 implementation in the stacked dbc322f4 branch with the 16-column batched QR352 CUTE update path from 31f5bdca; preserve all n=1024 predicate-sharing helpers, n=512 routing-reduction paths, QR32, n=176, n=512 structural, 4096 upper paths, exact dispatch gates, and torch.geqrf fallback.

Specialize only the active dense fallback n=2048 batch-8 and n=4096 batch-2 paths: benchmark torch.geqrf, torch.linalg.qr, and any existing safe fallback variants behind exact shape guards, keep the fastest per-shape dispatch, and avoid structural or CUTE shortcuts unless they require no new predicates or data-dependent scans.

Replace only the QR352 batching implementation in the combined best 3b663021 branch with the 24-column QR352 CUTE update kernel from 92a1e12; preserve all stacked n=1024 predicate-sharing helpers, n=512 routing-reduction paths, QR32, n=176, n=512 structural, 4096 upper paths, exact gates, and torch.geqrf fallback.

Starting from the 24-column QR352 best, reduce remaining QR352 launch overhead by batching two adjacent Householder panel columns per launch or trying intermediate 20- and 22-column update tile sizes between the 16- and 24-column winners; preserve exact n=352 dispatch and revert unless full validation plus n=352 and geomean improve.
